evidence.detail: Put seasons in the right order in /matchups — removed the manual reordering hack that moved All Time to the front; now uses all_seasons() directly since all_seasons() already returns reversed order with All Time first
self.seasons now built directly from self.all_seasons() which returns [All Time, Season N, ..., Season 1]

triage.notes: Issue filed 2024-05-11; fix landed 2024-06-11. Commit message confirms the prior code was doing a manual splice to move 'All Time' to front, which broke when all_seasons() itself was updated to put All Time first.
triage.proposed_comment: Fixed in commit ff624237 (2024-06-11): the season dropdown on /matchups/ now correctly uses the standard all_seasons() order (All Time first, then newest to oldest).
